figures.caption: Figure 7. Jump statistic plots from MD simulations at 450 K of Li6PS5Cl with all chloride (a) on site 4a (outside the cages) and (b) on site 4c (inside the cages). The lines represent the three diﬀerent types of jumps: green for doublet, blue for intracage, and red for intercage. Thicker lines represent larger jump rates. The colored spheres indicate S at site 4c (black), Cl at site 4c (pink), and Li-ion sites (48h) (yellow). the MD simulation. Placing all the Cl ions at the 4c sites also leads to a low Li diﬀusivity, however, not because of the intercage jump rate. In contrast, the Cl ions on the 4c sites induce a very high intercage jump rate, but the doublet jump rate decreases drastically and becomes rate-limiting, thereby causing the intercage jumps to become a local motional process.
